Title: Seminar
NewsSummary: Seminar Series: teaching and Learning Network
NewsContent:
​The Seminar was held on Nov 29, 2016 through VC. AKU staff from various locations of AKU campuses across East Africa and Pakistan participated in the seminar.​ ​The Seminar engaged the participants in the discussion of unpacking the term "Critical Thinking". The presenter of the seminar shared a few examples from the real classroom promoting the Critical Thinking among students.
